name: Substrates
description: Template and section marketplace (TanStack Start + Nitro SSR on Heroku).

NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION.description: Install devDependencies (Vite, Nitro, TypeScript) during Heroku build.

NITRO_PRESET.description: Nitro deploy preset; must be node-server on Heroku.

VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY.description: Firebase web API key (public; baked at build and used at SSR).

FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Firebase Admin private key PEM (use \n in one line on Heroku).

CRON_SECRET.description: Bearer secret for cron HTTP routes (Scheduler).

CRON_SECRET_PREVIOUS.description: Optional previous cron secret during rotation.

LEMONSQUEEZY_API_KEY.description: Lemon Squeezy API key for checkout and portal.

LEMONSQUEEZY_TEST_MODE.description: Set when store is in test mode.

LEMONSQUEEZY_ALLOW_TEST_IN_PROD.description: Allow test webhooks in production (dangerous; default off).

LEMONSQUEEZY_VARIANT_ID_SECTIONS_TEMPLAT.description: Variant id for Sections + Templates subscription.

LEMONSQUEEZY_VARIANT_ID_LIFETIME.description: Variant id for Lifetime one-time purchase.

LEMONSQUEEZY_VARIANT_ID_VIDEO_MONTHLY.description: Variant id for Video Skills monthly plan.

LEMONSQUEEZY_VARIANT_ID_VIDEO_YEARLY.description: Variant id for Video Skills yearly plan.

SENTRY_DSN.description: Sentry DSN for server error reporting (optional).

VITE_SENTRY_DSN.description: Sentry DSN for browser bundle (optional, build-time).
